# filesystem

Types from PocketBase's Go package `filesystem`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [filesystem](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/filesystem).

## filesystem.FileReader

FileReader defines an interface for a file resource reader.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `open()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#ioreadseekcloser">io.ReadSeekCloser</a></code> |  |

## filesystem.File

File defines a single file [`io.readSeekCloser`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#ioreadseekcloser) resource.

The file could be from a local path, multipart/form-data header, etc.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `reader` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemfilereader">FileReader</a></code> |  |
| `name` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `originalName` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `size` | <code>number</code> |  |
| `asMap()` | <code>(): { [key: string]: any }</code> | AsMap implements [core.mapExtractor] and returns a value suitable to be used in an API rule expression. |

## filesystem.MultipartReader

MultipartReader defines a FileReader from [`multipart.fileHeader`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/multipart#multipartfileheader).

|---|---|---|

| `open()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#ioreadseekcloser">io.ReadSeekCloser</a></code> | Open implements the [`filesystem.fileReader`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemfilereader) interface. |

## filesystem.System

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `driver()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob#blobdriver">blob.Driver</a></code> | PocketOne: Driver returns the filesystem's blob driver, e.g. to wrap it and pass it to `New`. |
| `setContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>): void</code> | SetContext assigns the specified context to the current filesystem. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close releases any resources used for the related filesystem. |
| `onNewWriter()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookhook">hook.Hook</a>&lt;<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemnewwriterevent">NewWriterEvent</a> &#124; undefined&gt;)</code> | OnNewWriter is a low level hook that is triggered on every new writer initialization (aka. when attempting to create a new file with `system.newWriter` or `system.upload`). |
| `onDelete()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookhook">hook.Hook</a>&lt;<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemdeleteevent">DeleteEvent</a> &#124; undefined&gt;)</code> | OnDelete is a low level hook that is triggered on every [`System.delete`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemsystem) call. |
| `exists()` | <code>(fileKey: string): boolean</code> | Exists checks if file with fileKey path exists or not. |
| `attributes()` | <code>(fileKey: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob#blobattributes">blob.Attributes</a>)</code> | Attributes returns the attributes for the file with fileKey path. |
| `getReader()` | <code>(fileKey: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob#blobreader">blob.Reader</a>)</code> | GetReader returns a file content reader for the given fileKey. |
| `getFile()` | <code>(fileKey: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob#blobreader">blob.Reader</a>)</code> | Deprecated: Please use GetReader(fileKey) instead. |
| `getReuploadableFile()` | <code>(fileKey: string, preserveName: boolean): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemfile">File</a>)</code> | GetReuploadableFile constructs a new reuploadable File value from the associated fileKey blob.Reader. |
| `copy()` | <code>(srcKey: string, dstKey: string): void</code> | Copy copies the file stored at srcKey to dstKey. |
| `list()` | <code>(prefix: string): Array&lt;(<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob#bloblistobject">blob.ListObject</a> &#124; undefined)&gt;</code> | List returns a flat list with info for all files under the specified prefix. |
| `upload()` | <code>(content: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;, fileKey: string): void</code> | Upload writes content into the fileKey location. |
| `uploadFile()` | <code>(file: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemfile">File</a>, fileKey: string): void</code> | UploadFile uploads the provided File to the fileKey location. |
| `uploadMultipart()` | <code>(fh: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/multipart#multipartfileheader">multipart.FileHeader</a>, fileKey: string): void</code> | UploadMultipart uploads the provided multipart file to the fileKey location. |
| `newWriter()` | <code>(fileKey: string, opts: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob#blobwriteroptions">blob.WriterOptions</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob#blobwriter">blob.Writer</a>)</code> | NewWriter returns a new blob.Writer instance allowing direct file create from an io.Reader value. |
| `delete()` | <code>(fileKey: string): void</code> | Delete deletes stored file at fileKey location. |
| `deletePrefix()` | <code>(prefix: string): Array&lt;Error&gt;</code> | DeletePrefix deletes everything starting with the specified prefix. |
| `isEmptyDir()` | <code>(dir: string): boolean</code> | Checks if the provided dir prefix doesn't have any files. |
| `serve()` | <code>(res: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/http#httpresponsewriter">http.ResponseWriter</a>, req: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/http#httprequest">http.Request</a>, fileKey: string, name: string): void</code> | Serve serves the file at fileKey location to an HTTP response. |
| `createThumb()` | <code>(originalKey: string, thumbKey: string, thumbSize: string): void</code> | CreateThumb creates a new thumb image for the file at originalKey location. The new thumb file is stored at thumbKey location. |
